category: per-address static residential proxy (dual-ISP native and broadcast) with dynamic residential and mobile GB products
tier: Static residential proxy, per IP, from $4.8 each

free_tier.stated: No standing free tier. New users can ask customer service, with the registered email, for a 1-day pack of a US static residential IP or datacentre IPs of all regions. Every standing product is paid, per IP or per GB.
free_tier.notes: The trial is issued by support on request, not self-service.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an address or a traffic pack, not an object

retention.stated: not applicable: an address, not stored bytes. The help centre has an article on whether an expired proxy can be recovered; its text was not read: unverified.
retention.notes: days is null because no bytes are stored.

egress.terms: Static residential: "无限流量与并发数" (unlimited traffic and concurrency); billed per IP.
egress.free_allowance: a 1-day pack of static residential US IPs or datacentre IPs of all regions, on request; the count is not stated

interface_detail: HTTP and SOCKS5, stated in the vendor description; the page states API support ("支持API接口"). Configuration guides are published for fingerprint browsers and V2rayN, clash verge and V2rayNG.
tooling: Any client that speaks SOCKS5 or an HTTP proxy, reached from a Worker through a relay that dials SOCKS5. The vendor publishes setup guides for fingerprint browsers; no SDK was seen. That is a note on tooling, not a reason to reject.
chaining: The upstream sees the leased address. The vendor labels the static product 双ISP原生与广播IP (dual-ISP native and broadcast IP) and 双ISP住宅属性; no address was published, so the registration class is unverified.

limits.value: one address per unit with unlimited traffic and concurrency stated; the vendor states 99.99% availability
none for the static product (unlimited traffic); dynamic products are metered per GB

binding_note: Traffic is unlimited, so the single address and its registration class bind; the label offers a choice between native and broadcast IPs, which are not the same class.

identity_cost.detail: Sign-up and login support a Google account, a WeChat account, an email address or a phone number; the trial pack is requested from support with the registered email. Payment: Alipay, Visa or Mastercard credit card, or USDT. No ID document is named on the pages read.

reliability_note: The vendor states 99.99% availability for its own backbone; no throughput, ban or replacement measurement was made.
confidence_note: Prices and product labels are read from the vendor home and register pages; trial, sign-up and payment terms from the help centre. The sign-up form and the delivered addresses were not seen.
price_per_tb_month: not applicable: an address, not a byte; from USD 4.8 per IP
notes: Named on the Chinese-language forum source (a post titled with the vendor name and "NS 专属价", an NodeSeek-specific price); the forum is the lead and the evidence is the vendor page. The vendor name in Chinese is 壹创云.
